sources.finding: Confirms per-copy plus consumed-charge tier and both mode tables; Grenade and Melee explicitly state recipient CES. Melee retains an obsolete multiple-charge bug line contradicted by the official 9.7.0 correction.

Melee Kickstart now activates for a full consumed melee charge even if another charge remains. Flechette Storm waits until returning to ground. Grenade multi-charge support unchanged; free Grapple from Tangles or Grappler no longer triggers Grenade Kickstart. Tempest Strike interaction fixed.

At least one Armor Charge is required; refunds depend on copies plus consumed charges. General non-Super chunk energy is recipient-scaled; the fixed modern tables come from Compendium and pinned Clarity.
Unpowered melee no longer consumes Melee Kickstart Armor Charge.

table.tier: paid Armor Charges (1..6) + equipped copies of this mod (1..3)
table.basis: base ability energy; apply the current selected recipient gain scalar/profile once

rules: Each mod source enables Armor Charge and contributes to its own slot-specific copy profile. Matching accepted ability_started uses authoritative paid/free fields, not arbitrary resource_spent or native hit facts.

Immediate policy requires at least one full unit actually paid, a nonfree use, positive Armor Charge and an available nonfull current recipient. Another remaining full ability charge does not suppress the trigger.

Capture the pool and matching-copy tier before consumption; consume the entire pool and verify actual negative stored_delta before granting the table reward. A single accepted use pays/refunds once even with multiple equipped copies or multiple full cost units.

Record every observed matching cast before benefit qualification. Shared finite identities survive rebinding/checkpoint, including free, insufficient-Armor, full/missing and deferred observations; independent new casts remain eligible.
chorus_d2:defer_kickstart excludes special use from immediate processing. It does not implement a later settlement. Flechette Storm landing and late Grapple/Tangle qualification remain explicit work.
Unknown skill-body world outcome retains prior accepted skill cost, Armor Charge payment and energy gain; actual world work is not replayed.

conflicts.source: Pinned Clarity Melee Kickstart multiple-charge bug line
conflicts.resolution: Use official 9.7.0 correction; test accepted full payment with more than one unit originally available. Do not preserve the older zero-energy-only behavior.

open_questions: Flechette Storm partial-cost accumulation/ground settlement, Tempest Strike skill content and Grapple/Tangle/Grappler free-use qualification are not implemented by this fixture. A later ordinary refund is not automatically a free cast and cannot rewrite an already-published paid fact.

The nonfull current-recipient guard, current selection/copy sampling, immediate ability_started timing and >=1 full-unit threshold are explicit Chorus policy; original timing, switching and special cost modifiers need calibration.

Utility uses the same generic base-energy pipeline; unlike Grenade/Melee, its selected Clarity entry has no explicit CES note. Original class ability exceptions and all current CES/CMS/stat mappings still need per-ability validation.
Synthetic tests use capacity 2, CES 0.5 and an optional x2 gain. A physical Shield Throw uses its existing 0.9 profile and calibrated projectile; this is not full weapon/skill-content coverage.

Formal armor slots, three-energy costs, legal copy limits, automatic production equipment/HUD and full physical-world save/restart remain incomplete. Definition is verification content excluded from release jars.
The tested sixty-second identity retention is not a gameplay cooldown or a global causal-cycle suppression; it is not infinite history deduplication.
